description: andrey-markin.com is Andrey Markin's personal site for AI/full-stack development services, offers, projects, courses, and a curated directory. It publishes its site content in machine-readable formats and provides a public contact submission endpoint.
summary: andrey-markin.com exposes one public HTTP API: a site content/read API with markdown pages, JSON indexes, RSS feeds, and a public contact-submit endpoint, described by an OpenAPI spec at `/openapi.json`; no authenticated developer surface was found.
